title: Bug: platform_tests/api/test_chassis.py does not support multiple vendor extension TLVs
author: roy-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

https://opencomputeproject.github.io/onie/design-spec/hw_requirements.html specifies that > 1 vendor extension TLV can be used.

`test_get_system_eeprom_info` in `platform_tests/api/test_chassis.py` does not cleanly handle the case when there are > 1 vendor extension TLVs in the syseeprom. The test assumes every eeprom field is a string. A small number of vendors return a list of vendor extensions in the sonic platform API.



### Steps to Reproduce

Run platform_tests/api/test_chassis.py on a platform with > 1 vendor extension TLV

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The expected behaviour is allowing the test runner to specify more than one expected vendor extension fields in the host_vars. And then comparing against the vendor extensions read from the system's syseeprom.

This PR updates test_chassis.py to support multiple expected vendor extension fields.

Summary:

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
https://opencomputeproject.github.io/onie/design-spec/hw_requirements.html specifies that > 1 vendor extension TLV can be used.

test_get_system_eeprom_info in platform_tests/api/test_chassis.py does not cleanly handle the case when there are > 1 vendor extension TLVs in the syseeprom. The test assumes every eeprom field is a string. A small number of vendors return a list of vendor extensions in the sonic platform API.

#### How did you do it?
Updated the test case to handle the case of multiple vendor extensions in the form of a list. Also maintains support for when there is one vendor extension in the form of a string.
